headline: Child begged for life in 911 call as father killed family, sheriff says
author: Dhruti Shah

paragraphs.text: A Florida county sheriff’s office is investigating the killing of three young children and their mother in Plant City, in which one of the children appears to have called 911 while the shooting was taking place.
The gunman, whom authorities identified as the father of the children, then took his own life, Hillsborough County Sheriff Chad Chronister said.
Chronister told reporters on Thursday that authorities received a 911 call around 3:30 p.m. and heard what appeared to be gunshots.
“It’s an open line, and we can hear a male’s voice say, ‘Sorry, buddy.’ And we hear a loud bang,” he said.
“In the distance, we can hear a small child begging for his life. … Three or four times before we hear another loud bang,” Chronister added.
The sheriff said deputies arrived at the property about 10 minutes later and forced their way inside.
Five people, including a man, a woman and three children, ages 1, 3 and 5, were found dead from gunshot wounds, the sheriff said.
He identified the man as the father of the children and said authorities believe he killed them and their mother before taking his own life.
The victims’ identities have not been disclosed. Chronister said the family was not known to authorities in Plant City, which is in central Florida, east of Tampa.
The incident has left deputies and the dispatcher traumatized, he said.
